tables.name: UnitOfMeasure
tables.comments: This table is not utilized currently. May be worth removing

notes.content: do we want to store datatype with units? Do we want to also allow user-defined resolutions of datatypes?
These tables are currently not implemented. Old status change should probably be removed. Unit of measure could stay if we wish. Not hooked into item testing

We will use varchar(100) and convert on app level, or use computed valuedecimal column should we need to sort via number values. This is already done elsewhere on other app(s), so shouldn't really be a problem. We can limit it to lower varchar if we wish.

The only issue with using the same Attribute Definition (or important one) is I planned on using a trigger upon insert to update a view, and if that view updates with every attribute for every thing ever, it may cause problems. We need to reconcile this before continuing with locking this in

We can add the ComponentTypeId field to ComponentAttribute if we want to enforce, on a DB level, the attributes of a specific component type only being applied to the correct component. Instead of the app level (which I think is more reasonable, only fields a user sees are the ones associated with the component type)
Reason why we use a composite pk is to enforce uniqueness (only one row for each component-attribute join) as a byproduct instead of an additional UNIQUE constraint
